annotations.title: Follow the funds out of a wallet, hop by hop

description: Follow the main stream of money out of one wallet, hop by hop, until a dead end: an exchange (with the deposit address), a bridge, a mixer, a swap (it names the asset bought, to follow next), a split, money at rest, or the hop limit. On Solana, an EVM chain, Bitcoin or Tron. Each hop says how the money went: sent, an account closed into the next wallet, control of a token account handed over (nothing moves, the owner changes), a stake account's withdraw rights handed over, or put into a DeFi position. On Solana, a wallet assigned to a program ends the walk (its key no longer controls it); an address no key controls (a pool's vault, an escrow) ends it naming the program; money put into a liquidity position (Orca, Raydium CLMM, Meteora DLMM and DAMM v2), a lending position (Kamino, marginfi, Save), a Jupiter DCA or limit order or a Marinade unstake ticket is read back from the position: who owns it and what left it since (liquidity removed, borrowed, filled, claimed, to which wallet), and the walk goes on from the wallet paid. One wallet per call. Costs 2 credits, or without an API key $0.10 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Can take up to two minutes.

address.description: The wallet to follow from: Solana or Tron base58, 0x (EVM) or Bitcoin.

asset.description: Optional: "native" (SOL, ETH...), or a token's mint or contract. Whatever left the wallet otherwise (dollars first).

chain.description: The chain, when the address's form doesn't say it: an EVM chain for a 0x address (ethereum by default).

since.description: Optional: only outflows from this time on (Unix seconds), e.g. a hack's time.
